name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 78 – Am 47
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 78b. Regrets that the Commission does not state whether it recognises Hamas’s strategic communication as FIMI or whether the EEAS specifically monitors Hamas as a FIMI actor1a; calls on the EEAS to systematically monitor, attribute and expose Hamas-led social-media information operations targeting audiences in the EU and to report regularly to Parliament; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Answer of 24July 2025 to Written Question E-002236/2025.
